summary.business_type: E-commerce (consumer tech / gadgets / electronics retail) — WordPress + WooCommerce + Yoast SEO, Rehub theme + Elementor, Hostinger hcdn
summary.field_data_note: No Google API (CrUX/PSI/GSC/GA4), no Moz/Bing, no DataForSEO credentials. Performance and AI-visibility findings are lab/heuristic from real fetches; live SERP/field data unavailable.
summary.pages_discovered: ~9,500-14,500 URLs across 171 child sitemaps (311 live products, 360 trashed products, 147 posts, 34 product categories, 9 categories, ~165 pa_* attribute archives, 12 pages)
top_findings: Every product image uses a broken concatenated URL (wp-content/uploads/https://m.media-amazon.com/...) — images 404 on cold cache and ALL product rich results are disqualified sitewide
360 of 671 product sitemap URLs (54%) are __trashed slugs returning HTTP 200 with index,follow — massive index bloat and brand-damaging URLs
Zero trust infrastructure: no About, Contact, Privacy, Returns, or Shipping pages (all 404) — primary E-E-A-T trust failure for a store taking card payments
Identical boilerplate meta description on 311+ products, the shop page, and homepage ('Discover the latest tech and gadgets at TechWhizMart...')
Product schema missing brand, gtin/mpn, itemCondition, and Offer-level price — fails Google merchant-listing eligibility
quick_wins: Create /llms.txt (currently 404) listing shop, categories, blog, key pages
Set Elementor homepage hero heading to an H1 tag (homepage currently has zero H1)
Toggle all pa_* taxonomies to 'No' in Yoast to drop 163 attribute sitemaps in one step
Fix robots.txt duplicate User-agent:* block and change Sitemap line to https://
Add one .htaccess block for the 5 missing security headers (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy)
Empty WooCommerce Trash to remove 360 __trashed products

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS enforced; HTTP/2 active; www -> non-www 301; trailing-slash 301 normalization
Utility pages (cart/checkout/my-account) correctly serve noindex,follow at the meta level
Indexable products/categories have correct self-referencing canonicals; ?orderby sort params canonicalize back to /shop/
404s return correct status; pa_* attribute term archives serve noindex

findings.title: robots.txt duplicate User-agent:* block nullifies WooCommerce Disallows
findings.description: A second 'User-agent: *' group (Yoast block) with an empty 'Disallow:' acts as the most permissive matching rule (RFC 9309), undermining /*?add-to-cart= and private upload-dir blocks. Sitemap directive also declared as http://.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate into a single User-agent:* group with all directives; set 'Sitemap: https://techwhizmart.com/sitemap_index.xml'.

findings.title: 360 trashed product URLs indexed (HTTP 200, index,follow, self-canonical)
findings.description: 54% of the product sitemap is __trashed slugs serving 200 with index,follow and self-referencing canonicals — Google is invited to index 360 defunct products. ~870-1,370 wasted crawls/cycle when combined with attribute archives.
findings.recommendation: Empty WooCommerce Trash (permanent delete) or 410/redirect + noindex; resubmit product-sitemap.xml in GSC.

findings.title: 163 pa_* attribute sitemaps flood the index with ~500-1,000 noindexed URLs
findings.description: 95% of 171 child sitemaps are WooCommerce attribute archives (pa_brand=252 URLs, etc.). Pages are noindexed but still submitted, forcing fetch/crawl/discard and suppressing crawl of 311 real products.
findings.recommendation: Yoast > Search Appearance > Taxonomies: set every pa_* to 'Show in search results: No' (drops noindex + sitemap together), or use wpseo_sitemap_exclude_taxonomy filter.

findings.title: Five critical security headers missing sitewide
findings.description: HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy all absent; only CSP present is 'upgrade-insecure-requests' (not a real policy). X-Powered-By discloses PHP/8.2.30.
findings.recommendation: Add a single .htaccess <IfModule mod_headers.c> block setting all five headers + unset X-Powered-By; submit to HSTS preload after 6 weeks.

findings.title: All 171 child sitemaps declared http:// on an https:// site
findings.description: sitemap_index.xml and robots.txt reference http:// child sitemaps, adding a redirect hop per fetch and origin ambiguity in GSC. Indicates WP Site Address was never moved to https.
findings.recommendation: Settings > General: set WordPress Address + Site Address to https://; flush Yoast + hcdn cache.

findings.title: Utility/duplicate pages in sitemap; 3 blog index pages
findings.description: cart, checkout, my-account, wishlist, compare-products, sample-page are in page-sitemap despite noindex; plus /our-blog/, /blog/, /blog-posts/ duplicate indexes and a tagline-slug page.
findings.recommendation: Exclude each via Yoast per-page 'Show in search results: No'; delete sample-page; consolidate to one blog index with 301s.

findings.title: add-to-cart crawl sets session cookies; blank.gif placeholders in image sitemap
findings.description: /?add-to-cart= returns 200 + WooCommerce session cookies (crawlable if C1 unfixed). Homepage sitemap lists 30+ blank.gif placeholders from Rehub lazy-load.
findings.recommendation: Fix robots.txt (C1); fix lazy-load so real image src is emitted; both flow into the sitemap automatically.

findings.title: Author + product_tag archives submitted (thin)
findings.description: author-sitemap exposes the store's own WooCommerce account; 164 post tags for 147 posts (near 1:1) = thin tag archives.
findings.recommendation: Yoast: disable Author archives; set Tags taxonomy to No until curated to ~20-40 topics.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage and product titles are reasonable length and keyword-relevant
Product pages do carry an H1; blog exists (147 posts) providing some topical surface

findings.title: Zero trust infrastructure — no About/Contact/Privacy/Returns/Shipping pages
findings.description: All return 404; footer is only a copyright line. Highest-weighted QRG Trustworthiness factor fails for a store taking card payments. No author bios, address, or trust badges.
findings.recommendation: Create and interlink About, Contact, Privacy Policy, Returns/Refund, and Shipping pages; add to footer nav; add business contact details.

findings.title: Identical boilerplate meta description on 311+ products + shop + home
findings.description: Every page returns the same 220-char 'Discover the latest tech and gadgets at TechWhizMart...' string in meta description, og:description, and Yoast WebPage schema description.
findings.recommendation: Set a Yoast product meta-description template using %%wc_shortdesc%% / variables; write unique descriptions for top pages and categories.

findings.title: Blog shows AI-content-farm patterns and off-topic, stale content
findings.description: 9 of 10 sampled posts are about drone/travel photography (unrelated to the keyboards/audio/gaming catalog); one post repeats 'DJI Mavic 2 Pro' as an H2 ten times; a '2021' phone guide carries a current title but lists iPhone 12/Galaxy S21. No author credentials/bio.
findings.recommendation: Audit all 147 posts; redirect/prune off-topic and stale content; rebuild blog around buyer-journey topics matching the real catalog; add a credentialed author bio.

findings.title: ~199 category + attribute archives have no descriptive content
findings.description: 34 product categories have empty description fields and no meta description; pa_* archives have no H1/description and as few as 2 products.
findings.recommendation: Noindex pa_* archives; add 150-250 words of buying-guide copy to each product category description field.

findings.title: Homepage has no H1 and thin above-the-fold copy
findings.description: Elementor renders the hero heading as a styled span; zero <h1> on the homepage, weakening topical anchoring for users, Google, and AI crawlers.
findings.recommendation: Set the hero heading widget HTML tag to H1 with a descriptive phrase.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Self-referencing canonicals on indexable pages; OG tags present; viewport meta correct
Product titles descriptive; breadcrumb navigation present with BreadcrumbList schema

findings.title: Homepage missing H1
findings.description: Zero <h1> elements on the homepage (hero is a span/Elementor widget).
findings.recommendation: Convert hero heading to H1.

findings.title: Duplicate meta descriptions sitewide
findings.description: Same description string across products/shop/home (see Content C2).
findings.recommendation: Templated + unique meta descriptions via Yoast.

findings.title: Category/shop title tags read 'Archives'; /shop/ missing H1
findings.description: Category pages use generic 'Archives' titles with no unique intro; /shop/ has no H1.
findings.recommendation: Customize Yoast taxonomy title templates; add H1 + intro copy to shop and category pages.

findings.title: Meta description length over the truncation limit
findings.description: Homepage meta description ~230 chars; truncates in SERPs (~160 char target).
findings.recommendation: Trim primary meta descriptions to ~150-160 chars.

findings.title: Thin internal navigation (3 nav items for 10+ categories)
findings.description: Main nav exposes only Home, Blog, Drones despite 34 product categories — weak internal linking and discoverability.
findings.recommendation: Build a category-driven mega menu / footer category links.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Product + Offer + UnitPriceSpecification on products; WebSite + SearchAction, Organization, BreadcrumbList, WebPage sitewide
JSON-LD parses cleanly; no fabricated aggregateRating (correct given zero reviews)

findings.title: Broken product image URL in schema disqualifies rich results
findings.description: Product 'image' is a malformed concatenation: https://techwhizmart.com/wp-content/uploads/https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/...jpg — not fetchable. A crawlable image is required for Product rich results / merchant listings, disqualifying the entire ~311 catalog.
findings.recommendation: wp search-replace 'wp-content/uploads/https://' 'https://' (or host images locally) and verify images resolve.

findings.title: Offer missing direct price, priceCurrency, itemCondition
findings.description: Price only appears nested in priceSpecification > UnitPriceSpecification, not as Offer.price; itemCondition absent. Google merchant-listing requires these at the Offer level.
findings.recommendation: Add a woocommerce_structured_data_product filter to inject price, priceCurrency, and itemCondition: NewCondition onto the Offer.

findings.title: brand absent; sku is the WP post ID
findings.description: No brand on any Product despite named brands (JBL, GoPro); sku values are WooCommerce post IDs, giving zero product identity.
findings.recommendation: Inject brand from pa_brand; populate real SKUs and gtin12/mpn where available.

findings.title: No reviews / no aggregateRating star results
findings.description: All products 0.0/5 with zero reviews; no star snippets available (schema correctly omits ratings).
findings.recommendation: Enable WooCommerce reviews + post-purchase review-request emails; ratings will emit automatically once real reviews exist.

findings.title: Organization sameAs has one profile; no contactPoint; blank home image
findings.description: sameAs = single Pinterest AU URL; no contactPoint; homepage primaryImageOfPage / og:image resolves to a 1x1 blank.gif placeholder.
findings.recommendation: Add all social profiles in Yoast; add contactPoint; set a real 1200x630 homepage/OG image.

findings.title: No FAQPage schema on buying-guide content
findings.description: None of the 147 posts carry FAQPage JSON-LD — a primary AI-extraction mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Add 3-5 Q&A FAQPage blocks to buying-guide posts.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: HTTP/2 active (HTTP/3 advertised via alt-svc); most images carry width/height; product images use lazy-loading and decoding=async
Some Google Fonts already self-hosted via Elementor

findings.title: LCP hero image blocked by lazyload/fetchpriority conflict
findings.description: Hero has fetchpriority=high but also class=lazyload with the real URL only in data-src — the browser fetches a 43-byte GIF placeholder first; the real image waits for JS.
findings.recommendation: Put the real image URL in src, remove lazyload on the LCP element, add <link rel=preload as=image> in <head>.

findings.title: HTML not CDN-cached; TTFB ~692-876 ms
findings.description: x-hcdn-cache-status: DYNAMIC with cache-control max-age=0 — every HTML hit reaches origin PHP/WooCommerce (cart-fragments).
findings.recommendation: Enable LiteSpeed/WP Rocket full-page caching with WooCommerce cart exclusions; target edge TTFB <200 ms.

findings.title: 32 render-blocking CSS files + 30 of 43 scripts without defer/async
findings.description: 32 synchronous stylesheets in <head>; jQuery + migrate sync in head; ~28 footer scripts undeferred (Elementor, owl.carousel, Rehub, plugins).
findings.recommendation: Inline critical CSS + async the rest; defer non-critical JS; deactivate unused plugins (Embed Any Document, Content Views).

findings.title: Zero WebP/AVIF images sitewide; product images bypass WP processing
findings.description: No WebP/AVIF on either page; product images proxied from Amazon CDN bypass WP image pipeline, preventing conversion/resizing; undersized (500x500, below 800px).
findings.recommendation: Enable Imagify/ShortPixel; import and locally store product images at >=800px; serve WebP.

findings.title: Render-blocking external Google Fonts + http font CSS
findings.description: External fonts.googleapis.com request plus 3 Elementor font CSS files referenced over http://.
findings.recommendation: Self-host the remaining font; add preconnect; regenerate Elementor files so URLs are https.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: robots.txt does not block AI crawlers (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended all allowed)
Organization + Product + Breadcrumb schema give some entity grounding

findings.title: No /llms.txt
findings.description: /llms.txt returns 404 — AI agents cannot discover the content inventory or licensing intent.
findings.recommendation: Publish a minimal /llms.txt listing shop, categories, blog, and key buying guides.

findings.title: Incomplete Product schema limits shopping-answer citations
findings.description: Missing brand, aggregateRating, gtin/mpn, additionalProperty specs and a valid image weakens Bing Copilot / Perplexity / AI Overview product citations.
findings.recommendation: Complete Product schema (see Schema category).

findings.title: Weak brand/entity signals (sameAs, no YouTube)
findings.description: Single Pinterest sameAs; no YouTube presence (YouTube correlates strongly with AI citation frequency).
findings.recommendation: Expand sameAs (YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook); build a YouTube channel over time.

findings.title: No FAQ schema; homepage no H1 weakens passage extraction
findings.description: No FAQPage on guides; missing H1 prevents AI crawlers anchoring the entity; stale 2021 content creates recency mismatch.
findings.recommendation: Add FAQ schema to guides; fix homepage H1; refresh/redirect stale posts.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Most images carry explicit width/height (good CLS posture); responsive srcset on hero and product images; lazy-loading present on product gallery

findings.title: All product images use a broken double-URL pattern
findings.description: src/schema image = wp-content/uploads/https://m.media-amazon.com/... — likely 404 on cold cache, breaking product visuals sitewide and disqualifying image/Product rich results. Dependent on Amazon CDN policy.
findings.recommendation: Fix the import path (search-replace) and host images locally.

findings.title: Empty alt text on product gallery images
findings.description: 8 of 26 product images have alt='' — invisible to screen readers and Google Images.
findings.recommendation: Populate descriptive alt text (auto-generate from product title as a baseline).

findings.title: No WebP/AVIF; undersized product images
findings.description: No next-gen formats; product images 500x500 (below 800px rich-result threshold).
findings.recommendation: Convert to WebP; import at >=800px.

findings.title: Desktop logo has empty width/height; blank.gif placeholders indexed
findings.description: Logo img width=''/height='' causes CLS; Rehub blank.gif placeholders appear in image sitemap.
findings.recommendation: Set logo dimensions; fix lazy-load to emit real src.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Fix broken product image URLs sitewide (search-replace 'wp-content/uploads/https://' -> 'https://' or import images locally) and verify they resolve + are >=800px
Empty WooCommerce Trash to remove 360 __trashed product URLs (or 410/redirect + noindex); resubmit product-sitemap.xml in GSC
Fix robots.txt: remove duplicate User-agent:* block, consolidate directives, set Sitemap to https://
Create About, Contact, Privacy Policy, Returns/Refund, and Shipping pages; link in footer
Replace boilerplate meta descriptions: set a Yoast product template + unique copy for home/shop/top categories
Add Offer-level price, priceCurrency, itemCondition and brand to Product schema

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Drop 163 pa_* attribute sitemaps (Yoast taxonomy 'Show in search results: No')
Exclude utility/duplicate pages from sitemap; delete sample-page; consolidate 3 blog indexes to one with 301s
Set WordPress Site Address to https:// so all sitemap <loc> are https; flush caches
Add the 5 missing security headers via one .htaccess block; unset X-Powered-By
Set homepage hero heading to H1; add H1 + intro copy to /shop/ and category pages
Performance: enable full-page caching (TTFB<200ms), fix LCP hero lazyload, defer JS, inline critical CSS, enable WebP
Populate alt text on product images; populate real SKUs/GTINs

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Audit all 147 blog posts: prune/redirect off-topic (drone) and stale (2021) content; rebuild around buyer-journey topics matching the catalog
Add 150-250 words of unique buying-guide copy to each product category
Add FAQPage schema to buying-guide posts; publish /llms.txt
Enable WooCommerce reviews + post-purchase review-request emails to unlock star rich results
Expand Organization sameAs (YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook) + contactPoint; set a real 1200x630 OG/home image
Add credentialed author bio(s) for E-E-A-T

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Connect Google Search Console + GA4; monitor index coverage as trashed/attribute URLs drop out
Capture an SEO drift baseline (/seo drift baseline) and re-run after each deployment
Track Core Web Vitals via CrUX/PSI once an API key is configured
Re-run a full audit in 60-90 days to confirm index bloat cleared and rich results validate
Build reviews, backlinks, and topical blog authority continuously
